info.title: FSHRMS — Payroll API
info.description:
Compensation: salary basics + components, monthly payroll runs,
payslips, statutory deductions (EOBI / PESSI), gratuity calculator,
final-settlement preview, off-cycle payments, Eid bonus events,
bulk increment batches. Generates payslip PDFs to MinIO and hosts
the payroll-run saga.

tags.name: Payroll — Composites
tags.description: Composite read endpoints — server-side employee resolution and run rollups so the FE renders names and totals without fan-out.

tags.name: Bonus events
tags.description: Eid bonus planning + installment apply. Requires `payroll.read` / `payroll.admin`.

tags.name: Fiscal year
tags.description: Requires `payroll.read` / `payroll.admin`.

tags.name: Banks
tags.description: Bank catalog. Read for everyone; CRUD for HR/Accounts. Requires `payroll.read` / `payroll.admin`.

tags.name: Payroll analytics
tags.description: JSON aggregations for the /analytics dashboards. Requires `payroll.analytics.read`.

tags.name: Salary components
tags.description: Catalog of allowance + deduction component types. There is no salary structure / template — every employee is `basic` plus a per-employee selection from this catalog. Requires `payroll.read` / `payroll.admin`.

tags.name: Employee basic salary
tags.description: Per-employee monthly basic. Effective-dated — a revision closes the previous current row and inserts a new one. Requires `payroll.read` / `payroll.write`.

tags.name: Per-employee payroll settings + bank details
tags.description: Requires `payroll.read` / `payroll.write`.

tags.name: Employee off-cycle payments
tags.description: Requires `payroll.read`.

tags.name: Payroll runs
tags.description: Monthly run lifecycle: DRAFT → LOCKED → COMPUTED → APPROVED → POSTED. Requires `payroll.read` / `payroll.admin`.

tags.name: Payroll reports
tags.description: Standard exportable + statutory reports owned by payroll-service. Requires `payroll.reports.run`.

tags.name: Off-cycle payments
tags.description: Payments outside the regular monthly cycle: cash extras, special OT, ad-hoc bonuses, eid bonus installment apply rows. Requires `payroll.read` / `payroll.write`.

tags.name: Payroll config
tags.description: EOBI / PESSI / gratuity rates and canteen meal prices. Effective-dated. Requires `payroll.read` / `payroll.admin`.

tags.name: Final settlement preview
tags.description: Read-only simulation. Distinct from the actual termination payroll run. Requires `payroll.read`.

tags.name: Increment batches
tags.description: Bulk basic-salary revisions: annual cycle, mid-year adjustments, one-off promotions. Requires `payroll.read` / `payroll.admin`.

tags.name: Leave encashments
tags.description: Annual leave encashment payouts. Created in PENDING; HR marks PAID once disbursed (via a payroll run or off-cycle). Requires `payroll.read` / `payroll.write`.

tags.name: Sagas
tags.description: Visibility into durable saga rows for payroll runs (GENERATE_PDFS, FINALIZE_RUN). HR uses these to inspect an in-flight post step and re-arm a FAILED saga once the underlying issue is resolved. Requires `payroll.read` / `payroll.admin`.

tags.name: Gratuity calculator
tags.description: Read-only calculator. No stored balance, no caching — math is trivial. Requires `payroll.read`.

tags.name: Permanent advances
tags.description: Long-term salary advances. Two-stage approval (HR → Accounts) → DISBURSED → monthly deductions until CLOSED. Requires `payroll.read` / `payroll.write` / `payroll.advance.hr` / `payroll.advance.accounts`.

tags.name: Short-term advances
tags.description: Bulk advance request — N employees, single target month deduction. HR → Accounts approval → DISBURSED. Requires `payroll.read` / `payroll.write` / `payroll.advance.hr` / `payroll.advance.accounts`.

tags.name: Employee salary components
tags.description: Per-employee allowance + deduction lines. Single endpoint family for both; type comes from the catalog row. Requires `payroll.read` / `payroll.write`.

tags.name: Payslips
tags.description: Per-employee payslip reads, hold/release lifecycle, signed PDF URLs. Requires `payroll.read` / `payroll.admin`.

post.summary: Payslips whole-run — enqueue ZIP of every payslip PDF
post.description: Zips every payslip PDF that {@code PayslipPdfService.generateAll} has already written to MinIO for the named run. Skips payslips with no {@code pdf_object_key}. Throws if the run has no generated PDFs at all (finalize the run first). Requires `payroll.reports.run`.

post.description: Returns the payslip to the review state so the run's post step can promote it to PAID. Requires `payroll.admin`.

post.summary: Release a held payslip (HELD in POSTED run → RELEASE_PENDING).
post.description: The next compute picks this up and adds a HELD_SALARY_RELEASE earning line to that employee's new payslip. Requires `payroll.admin`.

post.summary: Hold a payslip (DRAFT or PAID → HELD)
post.description: Pre-post on a DRAFT payslip the post step skips the row; post-post on a PAID payslip the operator can later `release` in a future run. Requires `payroll.admin`.

Resets a FAILED saga to RUNNING at its current step with attempt_count=0. No-op for sagas in any other state. Use after fixing the underlying upstream issue (MinIO outage, etc.). Requires `payroll.admin`.

post.summary: Reset a COMPUTED run back to LOCKED
post.description: Drops every payslip and skip row on the run (payslip_lines cascade) and clears `computedAt` + `skippedCount`, leaving the attendance period locked so the operator can fix employee data and re-run `/compute`. Only valid in `COMPUTED`. Requires `payroll.admin`.

Lock attendance for the run's period
post.description: Verifies the period is already locked in attendance (the operator closes the month from the attendance side) and flips the run DRAFT → LOCKED. Does not command the lock: 409 if the attendance period isn't locked yet — close it in attendance first. Requires `payroll.admin`.
Builds payslips for every active employee against the locked attendance period. To re-compute after fixing data, use `/reset` first. Requires `payroll.admin`.

403.description: Caller holds neither payroll.read.team nor payroll.read.

get.summary: Self-serve payslips for the caller, by year
get.description: Resolves the caller's employee id server-side, fetches the year's payslips, and mints a short-lived signed PDF URL per row when generated.

get.summary: List payslips for an employee + year (paginated)
get.description: Self-serve when the path id matches the caller's employee id (resolved via employee-service /me). `payroll.read` / `payroll.admin` callers may read any employee (incl. DRAFT); a manager with `payroll.read.team` may read a direct report (posted only). Default sort is `periodMonth desc`.
Filtered listing for operator views and the admin dashboard's failed-sagas slice. Both filters are optional. Default sort is `updatedAt,desc`. Requires `payroll.read`.
Requires `payroll.read`.

Aggregate RUNNING + last-24h FAILED counts plus a per-name 24-hour failure-rate series for payroll-owned sagas (PAYROLL_RUN_POST, …). Mirrors the employee-service shape so the BFF can merge both sources. Requires `payroll.read`.

get.summary: Look up a saga by (name, correlationKey)
get.description: Useful for FE to find the saga linked to a payroll run, e.g. `/sagas/by-key?name=PAYROLL_RUN_POST&correlationKey=payroll_run:42`. Requires `payroll.read`.
Requires `payroll.read`.

Returns count + sums (basic, allowances, gross, deductions, tax, eobi, pessiEmployer, net) and HELD / RELEASE_PENDING counts as a single row. Optional `status` (PAID / HELD / RELEASE_PENDING / RELEASED) and `q` (case-insensitive `employeeCode` substring) match the same filters as `/payslips`, so the BFF can show a filter-aware rollup alongside the table. Requires `payroll.read`.

get.summary: Live run summary for FE polling
get.description: One call per poll. Returns status + live counts (`totalCount`, `progressCount`, `skippedCount`, `successCount`) and pre-aggregated payslip totals in a single response. Counts pulse every ~25 rows; totals come from a SUM over committed payslips so they move live mid-compute. Poll every ~1s while status is `COMPUTING` / `POSTING`; stop polling and load `/payslips` + `/skips` once status reaches `COMPUTED` / `POSTED`. Requires `payroll.read`.
Each row carries the actionable reason (`errorCode` + `message`) and the snapshot employee code/name so the FE can render and deeplink without an extra lookup. Requires `payroll.read`.
Optional filters: `status` (PAID / HELD / RELEASE_PENDING / RELEASED) and `q` (case-insensitive substring on `employeeCode`). Requires `payroll.read`.

get.summary: Run detail with server-side rollup + employee enrichment
get.description: Returns the run, a summary across all payslips matching the filters, and a paginated slice already enriched with employee name + code. Filters: `status` (PAID/HELD/RELEASE_PENDING/RELEASED) and `q` (case-insensitive `employeeCode` substring). Requires `payroll.read`.

get.summary: Runs in a fiscal year, each with a server-side rollup
get.description: Lists every run for the given fiscal year and computes the per-run summary (employees / gross / net / tax / EOBI / employer PESSI). Requires `payroll.read`.

Bundles current basic, basic history, effective component lines, the active component catalog, payroll settings, bank details (or null), gratuity, and the last 12 months of off-cycle payments. Replaces 8 fan-out calls. Requires `payroll.read`.
Requires `payroll.read`.

bankId.description: ID of a row in the banks catalog.

iban.description: Pakistan IBAN: PK + 2 digits + 4-letter bank code + 16 alphanumeric (24 chars).

accountNumber.description: Encrypted at rest. Returned only to HR / payroll roles.

CreateShortTermAdvanceBatchRequest.description: Bulk short-term advance request. All lines are deducted in full from the target month's payroll.

targetMonth.description: 1..12 — the payroll month to deduct in.

lines.description: One row per employee. Each employeeId must be unique within the batch.

ShortTermAdvanceLineInput.description: One employee + amount inside a batch. Amount is rupees.

lines.description: Per-employee detail. Included on detail reads, omitted on list pages.

AdvanceDecisionRequest.description: Optional note on an approval / rejection action.

CreateIncrementBatchRequest.description: JSON form for ad-hoc 1-line batches (promotion / retention) and direct uploads.

CreateIncrementBatchLineRequest.description: Add one line to a DRAFT increment batch. Per-line `effectiveFrom` overrides the batch default; omit to inherit it.

newIncomeTax.description: Optional new income-tax deduction (rupees). Replaces any current INCOME_TAX line if set.

effectiveFrom.description: Per-line override; falls back to the batch's effectiveFrom when null.

EmployeeSalaryDto.description: Effective-dated basic-salary row. Open-ended (effective_to=null) row is current.

calcType.description: Defaults to FLAT. PER_DAY restricted to EARNING.

defaultAmount.description: Hint HR can override per employee. Rupees.

SalaryComponentDto.description: Catalog row. All amounts are flat (no percentage, no formula).

defaultAmount.description: Optional default amount (rupees) HR can override per employee.

ReportJobDto.description: Async report job. Polled until status flips to READY, then the FE calls /reports/jobs/{id}/download.

startedAt.description: When the runner picked it up.

completedAt.description: When the runner finished (success or failure).

outputSize.description: Output file size in bytes; populated on READY.

PayRegisterRequest.description: Pay register report request — one specific payroll run.

payrollRunId.description: Payroll run id whose payslips form the register.

CreatePermanentAdvanceRequest.description: Long-term advance against future salary. Created in PENDING; HR approves first, then Accounts. All money fields are rupees.

bonusOffset.description: Rupees taken against bonus when paid.

annualLeaveOffset.description: Rupees taken against AL encashment when paid.

deductedTotal.description: Sum of all deductions applied so far, rupees.

disbursedAt.description: §7.payroll #38 — populated on disburse(). null until then.

RecordPermanentAdvanceDeductionRequest.description: Manual / off-cycle ledger entry for a permanent advance. The payroll runner writes its own rows directly via the service helper; this endpoint covers out-of-band deductions HR records by hand.

payrollRunId.description: Optional payroll run id this deduction belongs to.

periodYear.description: Calendar year of the run period.

periodMonth.description: Calendar month of the run period (1-12).

fiscalYearCode.description: Fiscal year code of the run period.

weekendsInPeriod.description: Count of WEEKEND-status days in the period. Renamed from sundaysInPeriod (§7.payroll #25); the system supports any day-of-week as the weekly off.

lines.description: Optional — included only on detail reads.

days.description: Days multiplier (PER_DAY only); fractional for half-days.

SagaResponse.description: Status snapshot of a durable saga row.

skippedCount.description: Count of employees compute could not produce a payslip for. Drill-in via GET /payroll/runs/{id}/skips.

progressCount.description: Rows processed by the currently-running step (compute or post). Updated every ~25 rows. Reset to 0 between steps and on /reset.

totalCount.description: Total candidates for the currently-running step. Set at saga kickoff: active payroll settings count for compute, unrendered payslip count for post. FE renders progressCount / totalCount.

RetrySkipsRequest.description: Re-run compute for previously-skipped employees on a COMPUTED run. Empty/omitted `employeeIds` retries every skip row on the run; otherwise only the listed employees are retried. Ids that aren't currently skipped are quietly ignored.

employeeIds.description: Subset of employees to retry; omit or pass an empty list to retry every skip.

CreatePayrollConfigRequest.description: Inserts a new effective-dated row and closes the previous one.

canteenPerDayRateManagement.description: Canteen meal price (rupees per meal) for MANAGEMENT-grade employees. Defaults to 0 when omitted.

canteenPerDayRateOther.description: Canteen meal price (rupees per meal) for SUPERVISOR / LABOUR grades. Defaults to 0 when omitted.

eobiAmount.description: Monthly EOBI deduction in rupees (employee share).

pessiSalaryCap.description: PESSI cap on gross in rupees.

canteenPerDayRateManagement.description: Canteen meal price (rupees per meal) for MANAGEMENT-grade employees. Compute charges weeks-with-canteen × (rate × 7).

canteenPerDayRateOther.description: Canteen meal price (rupees per meal) for SUPERVISOR / LABOUR grades. Compute charges days × rate.

CreateLeaveEncashmentRequest.description: Cash out unused annual leaves. Amount = days × (basicSalary / 26). One row per (employee, calculationMonth).

periodInMonths.description: Period length in months — usually 12 (annual cycle).

basicSalary.description: Snapshot basic salary used for the calc, rupees.
Snapshot basic at calc time, rupees.

payrollRunId.description: Optional payroll run id when paid as part of a regular run. Leave null for off-cycle / cash payouts.

amount.description: Rupees. Optional — defaults to component.defaultAmount when omitted.
Rupees. Monthly for FLAT, per-day for PER_DAY.

RemoveSalaryLineRequest.description: Sets effective_to on the current row.

CreateBankRequest.description: HR/Accounts create payload for the bank catalog. The same row carries the company's own account at this bank — payroll runs read iban / accountNumber as the disbursement source. `code` must be unique and is immutable post-create.

accountTitle.description: Title of the company's own account at this bank.

BankDto.description: Bank catalog row. Carries the company's own account at this bank (payroll disbursement source) and serves as the controlled list employees pick from.

accountTitle.description: Title of the company's account at this bank.

ReorderEntryRequest.description: One entry of a bulk reorder payload — the new displayOrder for a catalog row.

displayOrder.description: New display order. Lower sorts first.

UpdateSalaryLineRequest.description: Closes the current row and inserts a new one with the new amount.

gratuityStartDate.description: When gratuity accrual began. Usually equals hireDate but can differ — set explicitly when prior service is recognised. Locked once set.

seniorAllowanceStartDate.description: When senior-allowance eligibility began. Null = ineligible. Set non-null to start accruing the seniority-tied allowance from that date.

gratuityStartDate.description: When gratuity accrual began. Falls back to hireDate when null.

seniorAllowanceStartDate.description: When senior-allowance eligibility began. Null = ineligible.

UpdateBonusEventRequest.description: DRAFT-only. Null fields are left unchanged.

UpdateBankRequest.description: Patch a bank catalog row. Null fields are unchanged. `code` is immutable.

SettlementPreviewDto.description: Read-only simulation. Same shape as the eventual termination payslip.

EmployeeSummary.description: Compact employee row for resolving names against an id list. Used by the approvals inbox, payroll composites, attendance composites, and any surface that comes back keyed by employee id without names attached.

employeeCode.description: Human-readable employee code (e.g. FS-2026-0042). Also the RFID/punch-card number used by attendance devices.

departmentName.description: Department name, looked up from the catalog.

sectionName.description: Section name, looked up from the catalog.

designationName.description: Designation title, looked up from the catalog.

profilePictureUrl.description: Signed URL for the employee's profile photo.

IncrementBatchLineWithEmployee.description: Increment-batch line with the employee resolved to a name + code.

PayslipQueueRow.description: Disbursement queue row: HELD / RELEASE_PENDING payslips with run period and employee resolved.

MyPayslipRow.description: Self-serve payslip row: the upstream payslip plus a short-lived signed PDF URL when generated.

pdfUrl.description: Short-lived signed MinIO URL — null when no PDF yet.

PayrollRunTotalsDto.description: Pre-aggregated totals for a payroll run, optionally filtered by status / employeeCode substring.

employeeCount.description: Number of payslips matching the filter.

pessiEmployer.description: Sum of PESSI employer contributions (cost only, not deducted).

heldCount.description: Count of HELD payslips within the filter.

releasePendingCount.description: Count of RELEASE_PENDING payslips within the filter.

PayrollRunSummaryDto.description: One-shot polling shape: status + live counts + aggregated payslip totals.

totalCount.description: Total candidates for the currently-running step. Set at saga kickoff.

progressCount.description: Rows processed so far (succeeded + skipped). Pulsed every ~25 rows.

skippedCount.description: Rows compute could not produce a payslip for so far. Pulsed every ~25 rows.

successCount.description: processed minus skipped. Server-derived so the FE doesn't have to subtract.

totals.description: Pre-aggregated payslip sums (basic, allowances, gross, deductions, tax, eobi, pessiEmployer, net) plus HELD / RELEASE_PENDING counts. Live during compute because payslips commit per-row.

PayrollRunSkipDto.description: An employee that compute could not produce a payslip for, with the actionable reason. FE drives the fix-and-retry workflow off these rows.

errorCode.description: Stable error code; FE maps to a deeplink (e.g. NO_EFFECTIVE_SALARY → salary page).

message.description: Human-readable reason from the compute step.

PayrollRunSummary.description: Server-side rollup over a run's payslips so the FE doesn't sum 100s of rows client-side.

PayslipWithEmployee.description: Run-detail payslip row enriched with the employee summary so the table can render the name and department without a fan-out.

EmployeeSalaryTab.description: One-shot bundle for the per-employee salary tab — replaces 8 fan-out calls.

GratuityDto.description: Read-only gratuity calculator. Computed on demand from gratuity_start_date (falls back to hire_date) + current effective basic + payroll_config.

gratuityStartDate.description: Gratuity start date — falls back to hireDate when no override is set on employee_payroll_settings.

OffCyclePaymentRowWithEmployee.description: Off-cycle payment row enriched with the employee summary.

Authorization.description: Paste the access token returned from POST /auth/login (without the 'Bearer ' prefix).
Authorization.name: Authorization
